answer: Random handshake bonds: each new account locks 4 POA for 30 epochs and must finish one signed handshake with a randomly drawn older account within 10 minutes. An honest user locks 4 POA once; 1,000 fakes lock 4,000 POA. An attacker may wander into his own fakes as partners, but the public seed draws from 5,000 older accounts, so only 1,000/6,000, about 17%, of draws hit them and the rest need real owners. Jurors check each nonce against the pigment hash and the zephyr of timing data; a forged or missed handshake forfeits 50%.
